title: What goes to the server?
instruction: You are making a video for school. Which of these goes to the company’s server, and which stays with you?

items.text: A prompt in an online image generator
items.why: The generator needs it on the server, where it calculates.

items.text: A photo of your classmates that you upload to be edited
items.why: The editing happens on the server, so the photo is there.

items.text: A drawing in a drawing program without the internet
items.why: You send nothing; everything is in the computer.

items.text: A recording of your voice for online voice cloning
items.why: The clone learns from your recording on the server.

items.text: A video edited in an editor that runs offline
items.why: The editor works on your device.

items.text: A generated picture, until you download it
items.why: It was made on the server and it sits there.

items.text: A model that runs locally on your computer
items.why: A local model sends nothing anywhere.

debrief: An online tool calculates in the cloud, so everything you give it is on its server. Only what you do offline stays with you.
